name: win_pct_sd
meaning: Spread of regular-season win percentage across active clubs (pure luck alone is about 0.12)
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: year_to_year_corr
meaning: How much a club's win % repeats from one season to the next (0 = pure luck, 1 = fixed)
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: close_game_share
meaning: Share of regular-season games decided by 8 points or fewer
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: repeat_champion_rate
meaning: Share of seasons in which the champion is the previous champion
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: max_titles_in_20
meaning: Most titles one club wins in any 20-season stretch, averaged over leagues
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: worst_league_titles
meaning: Most titles one club wins in any 20 seasons in the single worst league
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: best_team_title_odds
meaning: How often the club with the strongest starters (hidden ratings) wins the title
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04; 'on paper' measured from hidden starter ratings

name: returner_avg_finish
meaning: Average division finish of a club in its first season back from exile (3.0 = league average)
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: returner_win_div
meaning: Share of returning clubs that win their division
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: returner_fifth_again
meaning: Share of returning clubs that finish 5th again
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: returner_top3_in_3
meaning: Share of returners that finish 3rd or better in their division at least once in their first three seasons back (owner: able to be competitive within three seasons)
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: returner_playoff_first
meaning: Share of returners that make the playoffs in their first season back (owner: never an automatic playoff spot)
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: exile_effect
meaning: Extra club rating in points (about half a win per point) two years after finishing 5th versus finishing 4th; converted from win % at 34 points per 1.00
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04

name: exile_double_early
meaning: Share of exiled clubs that get a top-8 pick on returning and then a top-16 pick in the next draft; in the v2 rules every returner gets a top-8 pick, so this is the share with a top-16 pick the next year
origin: v1 limit adapted to the v2 draft rule

name: stuck_at_bottom
meaning: Share of club-seasons that follow three straight bottom-two division finishes (exile years skipped)
origin: v1 limit accepted by the owner 2026-10-04
